hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the single parameter theta in F(theta)=G0(theta)*V(theta)^2 to p and q to recover the two canonical term factors.
required_assumptions: Associativity/commutativity of multiplication so V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta) equals G0(theta)*V(theta)**2
hypotheses.rationale: The two term factors are syntactically identical up to the parameter name; they are evaluations of a single product template.
